title: The Physician of Knowledge
english: Let us follow the soul to the physician of knowledge. If we hunger, let us receive the bread; if we have died, let us receive the resurrection. If we have fallen into ignorance, let us ask for wisdom from the Wisdom. But he drew us out [...]
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-early

title: Obstacle to Instruction
english: A word for the length of a word. And perhaps we have become an obstacle to the fatherly teaching. But the occasion calls for listening more intently to the sayings, so that, having been benefited from greater works.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-mid

title: Doxology of Works
english: Let us send back to God the doxology through his works, to whom belongs the glory both now and always and unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in paralyticum juxta piscinam jacentem u02-rem-close
